features.text: Adjustable horseshoe buttress for personalized ligament and patella support
Low-profile design perfect for moderate activity and daily use
Lightweight neoprene material ensures flexibility and breathable comfort
Front closure (FC) wraparound style allows easy application and adjustability
Supports mild MCL and LCL injuries, patellar tracking issues, and tendonitis
